---
title: "Read the Admin overview"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-03 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

See, at a glance, the state of every dog's vaccinations and the manager's
to-do list, and open any list behind a count.

## Applies to

Managers, at the start of each shift and whenever the to-do list needs
attention.

## Before you begin

- Admin is open. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).

## Procedure

1. Read the cards. Each card shows a number and what it counts.

   ![The Admin overview](/screenshots/manager/admin-overview.png)

   **Vaccinations**

   | Card | What it counts |
   |---|---|
   | **Dogs on the books** | Every active dog |
   | **Cleared to groom** | Dogs that may be groomed today |
   | **Can't groom** | Dogs whose rabies stops the groom until paperwork is confirmed |
   | **Expired** | Dogs with a vaccine past its date that does not stop a groom. Ask for updated paperwork at the next visit |
   | **No paperwork on file** | Dogs with a vaccine never received, or asked for and not in yet |
   | **Expiring soon** | Dogs with a vaccine about to expire. Ask for updated paperwork at the next visit |

   **Your to-do list** (the pale amber cards)

   | Card | What to do | Procedure |
   |---|---|---|
   | **Waiting to be verified** | Shots typed in with no copy, to check with the paper or the vet | [MGR-04](verify-shots.qmd) |
   | **Paperwork to check** | Copies saved for later, not yet read | [MGR-05](paperwork-to-check.qmd) |
   | **Checked by hand, to look over** | Shots a groomer checked against a photo, for your second look | [MGR-06](second-look.qmd) |
   | **Allergy changes to review** | Allergies taken off or made less severe | [MGR-07](allergy-reviews.qmd) |

   **The shop**

   | Card | What it counts | Procedure |
   |---|---|---|
   | **Staff working here** | Everyone who can sign in at the counter. The list behind it is where staff are added and changed, and where another manager's Admin access is reset | [MGR-09](staff.qmd), [MGR-10](reset-admin-access.qmd) |

   **Under the cards**

   | Box | What it is for |
   |---|---|
   | **Vaccination records** | Click **Open records tool ↗** to open the records tool in a new tab: the test bench for sample paperwork, AI prompts and models, and owner reminders. It is run by the person responsible for the database |
   | **How the AI is doing** | How often the AI read dates right, wrong, missed them or made them up, graded by whoever checked each copy it read. Shown separately for **Emailed PDFs** and **Photos** |

2. To open the list behind a card, click the card. Cards with a list show
   **Open the list →**. A card showing 0 has no list.
3. In a list, click a dog's name to open its card on the Check-in screen.
4. To return to the cards, click **← Back to the overview**, or click
   **Admin** at the top of the screen again.

## Result

The overview shows every count. When the to-do list is clear, each to-do card
shows 0.

## If something goes wrong

### Disputed

Two records for the same vaccine disagree. Compare them in the records tool,
which the person responsible for the database runs.
